# Cove 1.6.0
**Easier to start** - A three-step welcome window on first launch: connect Claude Code, pick what the island shows, and allow only what those picks need. Run it again from the menu bar with **Set Up Cove…**. - Settings is split into short pages: General, AI agents, Classes, Sports, Shelf, and Status and alerts, then Permissions, Connections and About. - Cove opens at login by default and says so if macOS drops a permission, with a button to fix it. - One updater, and releases signed with one certificate so permissions survive updates.
**New** - Reply to a finished Claude Code or Codex session right from its banner. - Today's agent recap in the AI tab: what ran, for how long, and how many files changed. - Pushes to your phone through ntfy when an agent finishes or needs you, with Allow and Deny. - Re-run a failed GitHub Actions run, or start its deploy workflow, from the island. - Drop a file on the notch to AirDrop it or keep it on the shelf. - Quick timers with a live countdown beside the notch. - iPhone-style charging animation, and the green and orange camera and mic dot. - The island works on external displays and can follow the pointer between screens. - A Terminal look, and a choice of outline, glow or tinted accent buttons.
Update through Settings → About → Check for Updates. Your existing Cove installation updates in place.
